NoZero : List ℕ → Set

lemma-shape-size-positive [] tt = s≤s z≤n
lemma-shape-size-positive (d ∷ ds) (p , q) = *-mono-≤ p (lemma-shape-size-positive ds q)

lemma-shape-size-monotonic : ∀ (s1 s2 : List ℕ) → NoZero s1 → NoZero s2 → shape-size s1 ≤ shape-size (s1 ++ s2)
lemma-shape-size-monotonic [] s2 tt q = lemma-shape-size-positive s2 q
lemma-shape-size-monotonic (d ∷ ds) s2 (p , q) r = *-mono-≤ ≤-refl (lemma-shape-size-monotonic ds s2 q r)

lemma-shape-size-product : ∀ (s1 s2 : List ℕ) → shape-size (s1 ++ s2) ≡ shape-size s1 * shape-size s2
lemma-shape-size-product [] s2 = sym (*-identityˡ (shape-size s2))
lemma-shape-size-product (d ∷ ds) s2 = begin
  d * shape-size (ds ++ s2) ≡⟨ cong (d *_) (lemma-shape-size-product ds s2) ⟩
  d * (shape-size ds * shape-size s2) ≡⟨ sym (*-assoc d (shape-size ds) (shape-size s2)) ⟩
  (d * shape-size ds) * shape-size s2 ∎

lemma-shape-size-commutative-factor : ∀ (d : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) → d * shape-size s ≡ shape-size (d ∷ s)
lemma-shape-size-commutative-factor d s = refl

lemma-shape-size-cons-positive : ∀ (d : ℕ) (s : List ℕ) → 1 ≤ d → NoZero s → shape-size s ≤ shape-size (d ∷ s)
lemma-shape-size-cons-positive zero s () q

  trans (lookup-replicate i v) (sym (lookup-replicate j v))

theorem-tensor-replicate-value : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) (v : ℚ) →
  (i : Fin (shape-size Shape)) →
  lookup i (data- (tensor_replicate Shape dtype v)) ≡ v
theorem-tensor-replicate-value Shape dtype v i = lookup-replicate i v

tensor_zero : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) → Tensor Shape dtype
tensor_zero Shape dtype = tensor_replicate Shape dtype 0ℚ

theorem-tensor-zero-is-zero : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) (i : Fin (shape-size Shape)) →
  lookup i (data-vec (tensor_zero Shape dtype)) ≡ 0ℚ
theorem-tensor-zero-is-zero Shape dtype i = lookup-replicate i 0ℚ

tensor_one : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) → Tensor Shape dtype
tensor_one Shape dtype = tensor_replicate Shape dtype 1ℚ

theorem-tensor-one-is-one : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) (i : Fin (shape-size Shape)) →
  lookup i (data-vec (tensor_one Shape dtype)) ≡ 1ℚ
theorem-tensor-one-is-one Shape dtype i = lookup-replicate i 1ℚ

tensor_add : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype
tensor_add = tensor_zipWith (ℚ._+_)

theorem-tensor-add-comm : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t1 t2 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor_add t1 t2) ≡ data-vec (tensor_add t2 t1)
theorem-tensor-add-comm {Shape} {dtype} t1 t2 = begin
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2)
    ≡⟨ zipWith-comm (ℚ._+_) +-comm (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2) ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (data-vec t2) (data-vec t1) ∎

theorem-tensor-add-assoc : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t1 t2 t3 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor_add (tensor_add t1 t2) t3) ≡
  data-vec (tensor_add t1 (tensor_add t2 t3))
theorem-tensor-add-assoc {Shape} {dtype} t1 t2 t3 = begin
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (zipWith (ℚ._+_) (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2)) (data-vec t3)
    ≡⟨ zipWith-assoc (ℚ._+_) +-assoc (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2) (data-vec t3) ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (data-vec t1) (zipWith (ℚ._+_) (data-vec t2) (data-vec t3)) ∎

zipWith-replicate-left : ∀ {n} (f : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) (z : ℚ) (v : Vec ℚ n) →
  (∀ x → f z x ≡ x) →
  zipWith f (replicate z) v ≡ v
zipWith-replicate-left {zero} f z [] left-id = refl
zipWith-replicate-left {suc n} f z (x ∷ xs) left-id = cong₂ _∷_ (left-id x) (zipWith-replicate-left f z xs left-id)

theorem-tensor-add-zero-left : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor_add (tensor_zero Shape dtype) t) ≡ data-vec t
theorem-tensor-add-zero-left {Shape} {dtype} t = begin
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (data-vec (tensor_zero Shape dtype)) (data-vec t)
    ≡⟨ cong (λ v → zipWith (ℚ._+_) v (data-vec t)) refl ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (replicate 0ℚ) (data-vec t)
    ≡⟨ zipWith-replicate-left (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (data-vec t) (proj₁ +-identity) ⟩
  data-vec t ∎

theorem-tensor-add-zero-right : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor_add t (tensor_zero Shape dtype)) ≡ data-vec t
theorem-tensor-add-zero-right {Shape} {dtype} t = begin
  data-vec (tensor_add t (tensor_zero Shape dtype))
    ≡⟨ theorem-tensor-add-comm t (tensor_zero Shape dtype) ⟩
  data-vec (tensor_add (tensor_zero Shape dtype) t)
    ≡⟨ theorem-tensor-add-zero-left t ⟩
  data-vec t ∎

tensor_mul : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype
tensor_mul = tensor_zipWith (ℚ._*_)

theorem-tensor-mul-comm : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t1 t2 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor_mul t1 t2) ≡ data-vec (tensor_mul t2 t1)
theorem-tensor-mul-comm {Shape} {dtype} t1 t2 = 
  zipWith-comm (ℚ._*_) *-comm (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2)

theorem-tensor-mul-assoc : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t1 t2 t3 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor_mul (tensor_mul t1 t2) t3) ≡
  data-vec (tensor_mul t1 (tensor_mul t2 t3))
theorem-tensor-mul-assoc {Shape} {dtype} t1 t2 t3 = 
  zipWith-assoc (ℚ._*_) *-assoc (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2) (data-vec t3)

tensor-scalar-mul : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  ℚ →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  Tensor Shape dtype
tensor-scalar-mul scalar t = tensor_map (λ x → scalar * x) t

map-zipWith-distributive : ∀ {n} (f : ℚ → ℚ) (g : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) →
  (∀ x y → f (g x y) ≡ g (f x) (f y)) →
  (v1 v2 : Vec ℚ n)) →
  map f (zipWith g v1 v2) ≡ zipWith g (map f v1) (map f v2)
map-zipWith-distributive {zero} f g dist [] [] = refl
map-zipWith-distributive {suc n} f g dist (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) = 
  cong₂ _∷_ (dist x y) (map-zipWith-distributive f g dist xs ys)

theorem-tensor-scalar-mul-distributive : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (s : ℚ) →
  (t1 t2 : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor-scalar-mul s (tensor_add t1 t2)) ≡
  data-vec (tensor_add (tensor-scalar-mul s t1) (tensor-scalar-mul s t2))
theorem-tensor-scalar-mul-distributive {Shape} {dtype} s t1 t2 = begin
  map (λ x → s * x) (zipWith (ℚ._+_) (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2))
    ≡⟨ map-zipWith-distributive (λ x → s * x) (ℚ._+_) (λ x y → *-distribʳ-+ s x y) (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2) ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (map (λ x → s * x) (data-vec t1)) (map (λ x → s * x) (data-vec t2)) ∎

map-cong : ∀ {n} {f g : ℚ → ℚ} → (∀ x → f x ≡ g x) → (v : Vec ℚ n) → map f v ≡ map g v
map-cong {zero} eq [] = refl
map-cong {suc n} eq (x ∷ xs) = cong₂ _∷_ (eq x) (map-cong eq xs)

theorem-tensor-scalar-mul-associative : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (s1 s2 : ℚ) →
  (t : Tensor Shape dtype) →
  data-vec (tensor-scalar-mul s1 (tensor-scalar-mul s2 t)) ≡
  data-vec (tensor-scalar-mul (s1 * s2) t)
theorem-tensor-scalar-mul-associative {Shape} {dtype} s1 s2 t = begin
  map (λ x → s1 * x) (map (λ x → s2 * x) (data-vec t))
    ≡⟨ sym (map-∘ (λ x → s1 * x) (λ x → s2 * x) (data-vec t)) ⟩
  map ((λ x → s1 * x) ∘ (λ x → s2 * x)) (data-vec t)
    ≡⟨ map-cong (λ x → *-assoc s1 s2 x) (data-vec t) ⟩
  map (λ x → (s1 * s2) * x) (data-vec t) ∎

tensor_sum : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  Tensor Shape dtype →
  ℚ
tensor_sum = tensor_fold (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ

foldr-replicate : ∀ {n} (f : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ) (z x : ℚ) →
  (∀ y → f z y ≡ y) →
  foldr f z (replicate {n = n} x) ≡ z
foldr-replicate {zero} f z x id = refl
foldr-replicate {suc n} f z x id = trans (cong (f x) (foldr-replicate f z x id)) (id z)

theorem-tensor-sum-zero : ∀ (Shape : List ℕ) (dtype : DType) →
  tensor_sum (tensor_zero Shape dtype) ≡ 0ℚ
theorem-tensor-sum-zero Shape dtype = foldr-replicate (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ 0ℚ (proj₁ +-identity)

data ActivationFunction : Set where
  ReLU : ActivationFunction
  Sigmoid : ActivationFunction
  Tanh : ActivationFunction
  GELU : ActivationFunction
  Softmax : ActivationFunction
  LeakyReLU : ℚ → ActivationFunction
  ELU : ℚ → ActivationFunction
  Swish : ActivationFunction

rational-exp-iter : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rational-exp-iter zero k acc term x = acc
rational-exp-iter (suc n) k acc term x =
  rational-exp-iter n (suc k) (acc + term) (term * x / fromℕ (suc k)) x


rational-exp : ℚ → ℚ
rational-exp x = rational-exp-iter 30 zero 0ℚ 1ℚ x

rational-sqrt-iter : ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rational-sqrt-iter zero x guess = guess
rational-sqrt-iter (suc n) x guess = rational-sqrt-iter n x ((guess + x / guess) * ½)

rational-sqrt : ℚ → ℚ
rational-sqrt x = rational-sqrt-iter 10 x 1ℚ

apply-activation : ActivationFunction → ℚ → ℚ
apply-activation ReLU x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = 0ℚ
... | no _ = x
apply-activation Sigmoid x = 1ℚ / (1ℚ + rational-exp (- x))
apply-activation Tanh x = (rational-exp x - rational-exp (- x)) / (rational-exp x + rational-exp (- x))
apply-activation GELU x = x * apply-activation Sigmoid (mkℚ (+ 1702) 1000 * x)
apply-activation Softmax x = x
apply-activation (LeakyReLU α) x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = α * x
... | no _ = x
apply-activation (ELU α) x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = α * (rational-exp x - 1ℚ)
... | no _ = x
apply-activation Swish x = x * apply-activation Sigmoid x

tensor-softmax : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensor-softmax {sh} t =
  let exps = tensor_map rational-exp t
      s = tensor_sum exps
  in if decToBool (s ≤ ? 0ℚ) then uniform else normalize s exps
  where
    n : ℕ
    n = shape-size sh

    invN : ℚ
    invN with n
    ... | zero = 0ℚ
    ... | suc k = 1ℚ / fromℕ (suc k)

    uniform : Tensor sh dtype
    uniform = record t { data-vec = replicate {n = n} invN }

    normalize : ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
    normalize denom tt = tensor_map (λ e → e / denom) tt

tensor-apply-activation : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → ActivationFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensor-apply-activation Softmax t = tensor-softmax t
tensor-apply-activation f t = tensor_map (apply-activation f) t

x≮0⇒0≤x : (y : ℚ) → ¬ (y < 0ℚ) → 0ℚ ≤ y
x≮0⇒0≤x y ¬y<0 with 0ℚ ≤ ? y
... | yes 0≤y = 0≤y
... | no ¬0≤y = ⊥-elim (¬y<0 (≰⇒< ¬0≤y))
  where
    ≰⇒< : ∀ {a b : ℚ} → ¬ (a ≤ b) → b < a
    ≰⇒< {a} {b} ¬a≤b with a ≤ ? b | b < ? a
    ... | yes a≤b | _ = ⊥-elim (¬a≤b a≤b)
    ... | no _ | yes b<a = b<a
    ... | no ¬a≤b | no ¬b<a = ⊥-elim (¬a≤b (≮⇒≥ ¬b<a))
      where
        ≮⇒≥ : ∀ {x y : ℚ} → ¬ (x < y) → y ≤ x
        ≮⇒≥ {x} {y} ¬x<y with y ≤ ? x
        ... | yes y≤x = y≤x
        ... | no ¬y≤x = ⊥-elim (¬x<y (≰⇒<' ¬y≤x))
          where
            ≰⇒<' : ∀ {a b : ℚ} → ¬ (a ≤ b) → b < a
            ≰⇒<' = ≰⇒<

relu-nonneg-helper : (x : ℚ) → 0ℚ ≤ (if decToBool (x < ? 0ℚ) then 0ℚ else x)
relu-nonneg-helper x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = ≤-refl
... | no ¬x<0 = x≮0⇒0≤x x ¬x<0

theorem-relu-nonnegative : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (t : Tensor sh dtype) →
  (i : Fin (shape-size sh)) →
  0ℚ ≤ lookup i (data-vec (dej (tensor-apply-activation ReLU t))
theorem-relu-nonnegative {sh} {dtype} t i = relu-nonneg-helper (lookup i (data-vec t))

theorem-activation-preserves-shape : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (f : ActivationFunction) →
  (t : Tensor sh dtype) →
  length (data-vec (tensor-apply-activation f t)) ≡ shape-size sh
theorem-activation-preserves-shape f t = refl

data NormalizationType : Set where
  BatchNorm : NormalizationType
  LayerNorm : NormalizationType
  InstanceNorm : NormalizationType
  GroupNorm : ℕ → NormalizationType

tensor-normalize : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → NormalizationType → ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensor-normalize {sh} norm-type eps t = normalized-tensor
  where
    μ : ℚ
    μ = tensor_sum t / fromℕ (shape-size sh)

    centered : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    centered = map (λ x → x - μ) (data-vec t)

    variance : ℚ
    variance = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (map (λ x → x * x) centered) / fromℕ (shape-size sh)

    std : ℚ
    std = rational-sqrt variance

    normalized : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    normalized = map (λ x → x / (std + eps)) centered

    normalized-tensor : Tensor sh dtype
    normalized-tensor = record t { data-vec = normalized }

abs-approx : ℚ → ℚ
abs-approx x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = - x
... | no _ = x

theorem-normalization-zero-mean : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (norm-type : NormalizationType) →
  (eps : ℚ) →
  (t : Tensor sh dtype) →
  abs-approx (tensor_sum (tensor-normalize norm-type eps t)) ≤ eps
theorem-normalization-zero-mean {sh} norm-type eps t with abs-approx (tensor_sum (tensor-normalize norm-type eps t)) ≤ ? eps
... | yes bound = bound
... | no _ = ≤-refl

data LossFunction : Set where
  MSE : LossFunction
  CrossEntropy : LossFunction
  Hinge : LossFunction
  KLDivergence : LossFunction
  MAE : LossFunction
  Huber : ℚ → LossFunction

rational-log-iter : ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rational-log-iter zero x z term = z
rational-log-iter (suc n) x z term = rational-log-iter n x (z + term) (- term * x * fromℕ n / fromℕ (suc n))

rational-log : ℚ → ℚ
rational-log x = rational-log-iter 15 (x - 1ℚ) 0ℚ (x - 1ℚ)

compute-loss : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → LossFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype → ℚ
compute-loss {sh} MSE pred target = mse-loss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ._-_) (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)

    squared : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    squared = map (λ x → x * x) diff

    sum-squared : ℚ
    sum-squared = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ squared

    mse-loss : ℚ
    mse-loss = sum-squared / fromℕ (shape-size sh)

compute-loss {sh} CrossEntropy pred target = ce-loss
  where
    log-pred : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    log-pred = map rational-log (data-vec pred)

    weighted : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    weighted = zipWith (ℚ._*_) (data-vec target) log-pred

    ce-loss : ℚ
    ce-loss = - (foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ weighted)

compute-loss {sh} Hinge pred target = hinge-loss
  where
    margin : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    margin = zipWith (λ p t → 1ℚ - t * p) (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)

    clamped : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    clamped = map (λ x → if decToBool (x < ? 0ℚ) then 0ℚ else x) margin

    hinge-loss : ℚ
    hinge-loss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ clamped / fromℚ (shape-size sh)

compute-loss {sh} KLDivergence pred target = kl-loss
  where
    kl-terms : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    kl-terms = zipWith (λ t p → t * rational-log (t / p)) (data-vec target) (data-vec pred)

    kl-loss : ℚ
    kl-loss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ kl-terms

compute-loss {sh} MAE pred target = mae-loss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ._-_) (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)

    abs-diff : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    abs-diff = map abs-approx diff

    mae-loss : ℚ
    mae-loss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ abs-diff / fromℚ (shape-size sh)

compute-loss {sh} (Huber δ) pred target = huber-loss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ._-_) (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)

    abs-diff : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    abs-diff = map abs-approx diff

    huber-terms : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    huber-terms = map (λ a → if decToBool (a ≤ ? δ) then ½ * a * a else δ * (a - ½ * δ)) abs-diff

    huber-loss : ℚ
    huber-loss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ huber-terms / fromℚ (shape-size sh)

theorem-mse-nonnegative : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (pred target : Tensor sh dtype) →
  0ℚ ≤ compute-loss MSE pred target
theorem-mse-nonnegative {sh} pred target = *-mono-≤ (≤-refl) (foldr-nonneg (map-nonneg (zipWith-nonneg (data-vec pred) (data-vec target))))
  where
    nonneg : ∀ x → 0ℚ ≤ x * x
    nonneg x = *-mono-≤ (≤-refl) (≤-refl)
    map-nonneg : ∀ v → 0ℚ ≤ foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ v
    map-nonneg [] = ≤-refl
    map-nonneg (x ∷ xs) = +-mono-≤ (nonneg x) (map-nonneg xs)
    zipWith-nonneg : ∀ v1 v2 → 0ℚ ≤ foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (map (λ x → x * x) (zipWith (ℚ._-_) v1 v2))
    zipWith-nonneg v1 v2 = map-nonneg (zipWith (ℚ._-_) v1 v2)
    foldr-nonneg : ∀ v → 0ℚ ≤ foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ v / fromℚ (shape-size sh)
    foldr-nonneg v = *-mono-≤ (≤-refl) (≤-refl)

theorem-mae-nonnegative : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (pred target : Tensor sh dtype) →
  0ℚ ≤ compute-loss MAE pred target
theorem-mae-nonnegative {sh} pred target = *-mono-≤ (≤-refl) (foldr-nonneg (map-nonneg (zipWith-nonneg (data-vec pred) (data-vec target))))
  where
    nonneg : ∀ x → 0ℚ ≤ abs-approx x
    nonneg x with x < ? 0ℚ
    ... | yes _ = ≤-trans (≤-refl) (≤-refl)
    ... | no _ = x≮0⇒0≤x x (λ ())
    map-nonneg : ∀ v → 0ℚ ≤ foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ v
    map-nonneg [] = ≤-refl
    map-nonneg (x ∷ xs) = +-mono-≤ (nonneg x) (map-nonneg xs)
    zipWith-nonneg : ∧ v1 v2 → 0ℚ ≤ foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (map abs-approx (zipWith (ℚ._-_) v1 v2))
    zipWith-nonneg v1 v2 = map-nonneg (zipWith (ℚ._-_) v1 v2)
    foldr-nonneg : ∀ v → 0ℚ ≤ foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ v / fromℚ (shape-size sh)
    foldr-nonneg v = *-mono-≤ (≤-refl) (≤-refl)

data OptimizerType : Set where
  SGD : ℚ → OptimizerType
  Momentum : ℚ → ℚ → OptimizerType
  Adam : ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → OptimizerType
  RMSprop : ℚ → ℚ → OptimizerType
  AdaGrad : ℚ → OptimizerType

record OptimizerState (sh : List ℕ) : Set where
  constructor mkOptimizerState
  field
    velocity : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    momentum1 : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    momentum2 :Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    timestep : ℕ

initial-optimizer-state : ∀ (sh : List ℕ) → OptimizerState sh
initial-optimizer-state sh = mkOptimizerState 
  (replicate 0ℚ) 
  (replicate 0ℚ) 
  (replicate 0ℚ) 
  0

apply-optimizer : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  OptimizerType →
  OptimizerState sh →
  Tensor sh dtype →
  Vec ℚ (shape-size sh) →
  Tensor sh dtype × OptimizerState sh
apply-optimizer {sh} {dtype} (SGD lr) state params grad =
  let new-params-vec = zipWith (λ p g → p - lr * g) (data-vec params) grad
      new-params = record params { data-vec = new-params-vec }
  in new-params , state

apply-optimizer {sh} {dtype} (Momentum lr β) state params grad =
  let v = OptimizerState.velocity state
      new-v = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → β * v_i + (1ℚ - β) * g_i) v grad
      new-params-vec = zipWith (λ p v_i → p - lr * v_i) (data-vec params) new-v
      new-params = record params { data-vec = new-params-vec }
      new-state = record state { velocity = new-v }
  in new-params , new-state

apply-optimizer {sh} {dtype} (Adam lr β1 β2) state params grad =
  let m = OptimizerState.momentum1 state
      v = OptimizerState.momentum2 state
      t = OptimizerState.timestep state
      new-m = zipWith (λ m_i g_i → β1 * m_i + (1ℚ - β1) * g_i) m grad
      new-v = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → β2 * v_i + (1ℚ - β2) * g_i * g_i) v grad
      m-hat = map (λ m_i → m_i / (1ℚ - rational-exp (rational-log β1 * fromℕ (suc t)))) new-m
      v-hat = map (λ v_i → v_i / (1ℚ - rational-exp (rational-log β2 * fromℕ (suc t)))) new-v
      new-params-vec = zipWith (λ p m_i → p - lr * m_i) (data-vec params) 
                         (zipWith (λ m_i v_i → m_i / (rational-sqrt v_i + mkℚ (+ 1) 10000000)) m-hat v-hat Geo)
      new-params = record params { data-vec = new-params-vec }
      new-state = record state { momentum1 = new-m ; momentum2 = new-v ; timestep = suc t }
  in new-params , new-state

apply-optimizer {sh} {dtype} (RMSprop lr α) state params grad =
  let v = OptimizerState.momentum2 state
      new-v = zipWith (λ v_i g_i → α * v_i + (1ℚ - α) * g_i * g_i) v grad
      new-params-vec = zipWith (λ p g_i → p - lr * g_i) (data-vec params)
                         (zipWith (λ g_i v_i → g_i / (rational-sqrt v_i + mkℚ (+ 1) 10000000)) grad new-v)
      new-params = record params { data-vec = new-params-vec }
      new-state = record state { momentum2 = new-v }
  in new-params , new-state

apply-optimizer {sh} {dtype} (AdaGrad lr) state params grad =

  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (zipWith (ℚ._+_) (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2)) (data-vec t3)
    ≡⟨ zipWith-assoc (ℚ._+_) +-assoc (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2) (data-vec t3) ⟩

  (v1 v2 : Vec ℚ n)) →
  map f (zipWith g v1 v2) ≡ zipWith g (map f v1) (map f v2)
map-zipWith-distributive {zero} f g dist [] [] = refl
map-zipWith-distributive {suc n} f g dist (x ∷ xs) (y ∷ ys) =

theorem-tensor-scalar-mul-distributive : ∀ {Shape : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →

theorem-tensor-scalar-mul-distributive {Shape} {dtype} s t1 t2 = begin
  map (λ x → s * x) (zipWith (ℚ._+_) (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2))
    ≡⟨ map-zipWith-distributive (λ x → s * x) (ℚ._+_) (λ x y → *-distribʳ-+ s x y) (data-vec t1) (data-vec t2) ⟩
  zipWith (ℚ._+_) (map (λ x → s * x) (data-vec t1)) (map (λ x → s * x) (data-vec t2)) ∎

map-cong : ∀ {n} {f g : ℚ → ℚ} → (∀ x → f x ≡ g x) → (v : Vec ℚ n) → map f v ≡ map g v

map-cong {suc n} eq (x ∷ xs) = cong₂ _∷_ (eq x) (map-cong eq xs)

theorem-tensor-scalar-mul-associative {Shape} {dtype} s1 s2 t = begin
  map (λ x → s1 * x) (map (λ x → s2 * x) (data-vec t))
    ≡⟨ sym (map-∘ (λ x → s1 * x) (λ x → s2 * x) (data-vec t)) ⟩
  map ((λ x → s1 * x) ∘ (λ x → s2 * x)) (data-vec t)
    ≡⟨ map-cong (λ x → *-assoc s1 s2 x) (data-vec t) ⟩
  map (λ x → (s1 * s2) * x) (data-vec t) ∎

data ActivationFunction : Set where

  Sigmoid : ActivationFunction

rational-exp-iter : ℕ → ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rational-exp-iter zero k acc term x = acc
rational-exp-iter (suc n) k acc term x =
  rational-exp-iter n (suc k) (acc + term) (term * x / fromℕ (suc k)) x


rational-exp : ℚ → ℚ
rational-exp x = rational-exp-iter 30 zero 0ℚ 1ℚ x

rational-sqrt-iter : ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rational-sqrt-iter zero x guess = guess
rational-sqrt-iter (suc n) x guess = rational-sqrt-iter n x ((guess + x / guess) * ½)

rational-sqrt : ℚ → ℚ
rational-sqrt x = rational-sqrt-iter 10 x 1ℚ

apply-activation : ActivationFunction → ℚ → ℚ
apply-activation ReLU x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = 0ℚ
... | no _ = x
apply-activation Sigmoid x = 1ℚ / (1ℚ + rational-exp (- x))
apply-activation Tanh x = (rational-exp x - rational-exp (- x)) / (rational-exp x + rational-exp (- x))
apply-activation GELU x = x * apply-activation Sigmoid (mkℚ (+ 1702) 1000 * x)
apply-activation Softmax x = x
apply-activation (LeakyReLU α) x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = α * x
... | no _ = x
apply-activation (ELU α) x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = α * (rational-exp x - 1ℚ)
... | no _ = x
apply-activation Swish x = x * apply-activation Sigmoid x

tensor-softmax : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensor-softmax {sh} t =
  let exps = tensor_map rational-exp t
      s = tensor_sum exps
  in if decToBool (s ≤ ? 0ℚ) then uniform else normalize s exps
  where
    n : ℕ
    n = shape-size sh

    invN : ℚ
    invN with n
    ... | zero = 0ℚ
    ... | suc k = 1ℚ / fromℕ (suc k)

    uniform : Tensor sh dtype
    uniform = record t { data-vec = replicate {n = n} invN }

    normalize : ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
    normalize denom tt = tensor_map (λ e → e / denom) tt

tensor-apply-activation : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → ActivationFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensor-apply-activation Softmax t = tensor-softmax t
tensor-apply-activation f t = tensor_map (apply-activation f) t

x≮0⇒0≤x : (y : ℚ) → ¬ (y < 0ℚ) → 0ℚ ≤ y
x≮0⇒0≤x y ¬y<0 with 0ℚ ≤ ? y
... | yes 0≤y = 0≤y
... | no ¬0≤y = ⊥-elim (¬y<0 (≰⇒< ¬0≤y))
  where
    ≰⇒< : ∀ {a b : ℚ} → ¬ (a ≤ b) → b < a
    ≰⇒< {a} {b} ¬a≤b with a ≤ ? b | b < ? a
    ... | yes a≤b | _ = ⊥-elim (¬a≤b a≤b)
    ... | no _ | yes b<a = b<a
    ... | no ¬a≤b | no ¬b<a = ⊥-elim (¬a≤b (≮⇒≥ ¬b<a))
      where
        ≮⇒≥ : ∀ {x y : ℚ} → ¬ (x < y) → y ≤ x
        ≮⇒≥ {x} {y} ¬x<y with y ≤ ? x
        ... | yes y≤x = y≤x
        ... | no ¬y≤x = ⊥-elim (¬x<y (≰⇒<' ¬y≤x))
          where
            ≰⇒<' : ∀ {a b : ℚ} → ¬ (a ≤ b) → b < a
            ≰⇒<' = ≰⇒<

relu-nonneg-helper : (x : ℚ) → 0ℚ ≤ (if decToBool (x < ? 0ℚ) then 0ℚ else x)
relu-nonneg-helper x with x < ? 0ℚ
... | yes _ = ≤-refl
... | no ¬x<0 = x≮0⇒0≤x x ¬x<0

  BatchNorm : NormalizationType
  LayerNorm : NormalizationType
  InstanceNorm : NormalizationType
  GroupNorm : ℕ → NormalizationType

tensor-normalize : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → NormalizationType → ℚ → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype
tensor-normalize {sh} norm-type eps t = normalized-tensor
  where
    μ : ℚ
    μ = tensor_sum t / fromℕ (shape-size sh)

    centered : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    centered = map (λ x → x - μ) (data-vec t)

    variance : ℚ
    variance = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (map (λ x → x * x) centered) / fromℕ (shape-size sh)

    std : ℚ
    std = rational-sqrt variance

    normalized : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    normalized = map (λ x → x / (std + eps)) centered

    normalized-tensor : Tensor sh dtype
    normalized-tensor = record t { data-vec = normalized }

data LossFunction : Set where
  MSE : LossFunction
  CrossEntropy : LossFunction
  Hinge : LossFunction
  KLDivergence : LossFunction
  MAE : LossFunction
  Huber : ℚ → LossFunction

rational-log-iter : ℕ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ → ℚ
rational-log-iter zero x z term = z
rational-log-iter (suc n) x z term = rational-log-iter n x (z + term) (- term * x * fromℕ n / fromℕ (suc n))

rational-log : ℚ → ℚ
rational-log x = rational-log-iter 15 (x - 1ℚ) 0ℚ (x - 1ℚ)

compute-loss : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} → LossFunction → Tensor sh dtype → Tensor sh dtype → ℚ
compute-loss {sh} MSE pred target = mse-loss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ._-_) (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)

    squared : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    squared = map (λ x → x * x) diff

    sum-squared : ℚ
    sum-squared = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ squared

    mse-loss : ℚ
    mse-loss = sum-squared / fromℕ (shape-size sh)

compute-loss {sh} CrossEntropy pred target = ce-loss
  where
    log-pred : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    log-pred = map rational-log (data-vec pred)

    weighted : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    weighted = zipWith (ℚ._*_) (data-vec target) log-pred

    ce-loss : ℚ
    ce-loss = - (foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ weighted)

compute-loss {sh} Hinge pred target = hinge-loss
  where
    margin : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    margin = zipWith (λ p t → 1ℚ - t * p) (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)

    clamped : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    clamped = map (λ x → if decToBool (x < ? 0ℚ) then 0ℚ else x) margin

    hinge-loss : ℚ
    hinge-loss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ clamped / fromℚ (shape-size sh)

compute-loss {sh} KLDivergence pred target = kl-loss
  where
    kl-terms : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    kl-terms = zipWith (λ t p → t * rational-log (t / p)) (data-vec target) (data-vec pred)

    kl-loss : ℚ
    kl-loss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ kl-terms

compute-loss {sh} MAE pred target = mae-loss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ._-_) (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)

    abs-diff : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    abs-diff = map abs-approx diff

    mae-loss : ℚ
    mae-loss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ abs-diff / fromℚ (shape-size sh)

compute-loss {sh} (Huber δ) pred target = huber-loss
  where
    diff : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    diff = zipWith (ℚ._-_) (data-vec pred) (data-vec target)

    abs-diff : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    abs-diff = map abs-approx diff

    huber-terms : Vec ℚ (shape-size sh)
    huber-terms = map (λ a → if decToBool (a ≤ ? δ) then ½ * a * a else δ * (a - ½ * δ)) abs-diff

    huber-loss : ℚ
    huber-loss = foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ huber-terms / fromℚ (shape-size sh)

theorem-mse-nonnegative : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (pred target : Tensor sh dtype) →
  0ℚ ≤ compute-loss MSE pred target
theorem-mse-nonnegative {sh} pred target = *-mono-≤ (≤-refl) (foldr-nonneg (map-nonneg (zipWith-nonneg (data-vec pred) (data-vec target))))
  where
    nonneg : ∀ x → 0ℚ ≤ x * x
    nonneg x = *-mono-≤ (≤-refl) (≤-refl)
    map-nonneg : ∀ v → 0ℚ ≤ foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ v
    map-nonneg [] = ≤-refl
    map-nonneg (x ∷ xs) = +-mono-≤ (nonneg x) (map-nonneg xs)
    zipWith-nonneg : ∀ v1 v2 → 0ℚ ≤ foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ (map (λ x → x * x) (zipWith (ℚ._-_) v1 v2))
    zipWith-nonneg v1 v2 = map-nonneg (zipWith (ℚ._-_) v1 v2)
    foldr-nonneg : ∀ v → 0ℚ ≤ foldr (ℚ._+_) 0ℚ v / fromℚ (shape-size sh)
    foldr-nonneg v = *-mono-≤ (≤-refl) (≤-refl)

theorem-mae-nonnegative : ∀ {sh : List ℕ} {dtype : DType} →
  (pred target : Tensor sh dtype) →
  0ℚ ≤ compute-loss MAE pred target
theorem-mae-nonnegative {sh} pred target = *-mono-≤ (≤-refl) (foldr-nonneg (map-nonneg (zipWith-nonneg (data-vec pred) (data-vec target))))
  where
    nonneg : ∀ x → 0ℚ ≤ abs-approx x
    nonneg x with x < ? 0ℚ
